subject: Reblock request — CTO flight merged with all-hands; propose compressed exec slot
messages:
From: Allison Murray <allison.murray@theodotech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-05T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: CTO travel conflict — need to reslot/demo compress?

Hi Rachel,

Quick heads-up: our CTO (Mitch Hayes) just had his flight moved and it now collides with the original demo window on July 9th. He still wants to join but will only be available for a short period (roughly the last ~20 minutes). We also have an executive all-hands that might run over, so the earlier part of the session is at risk.

Would Redwood be able to compress the technical demo down to 30 minutes and guarantee we still get a 15–20 minute executive sponsor segment at the end for Mitch? If that’s tight, could we instead push the demo back by 45–60 minutes on the same day?

We’re trying to avoid moving the customer-side engineers around too much — let me know what’s feasible from your end. I can loop in Mitch if needed, but for now I wanted to check with you and your team.

Thanks,
Allison Murray
Senior Product Manager
Theodo Tech

---
Attachment: none

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Murray <allison.murray@theodotech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-05T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CTO travel conflict — need to reslot/demo compress?

Hi Allison —

Thanks for the heads-up and the context. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate both options but I’d recommend compressing to a focused 30-minute demo + 20-minute exec Q&A (total 50 minutes) to keep the technical narrative intact while guaranteeing time for Mitch. Pushing back 45–60 minutes is possible but introduces risk for your engineers’ schedules and for Mitch’s connection to the all-hands.

Proposal:
- Keep the original date (July 9).
- New structure: 30m product + 20m exec sponsor Q&A/final remarks.
- Goal: reserve the last 20m strictly for Mitch. If he joins late, we’ll run the 30m product section and then enter the exec portion when he’s on.

I’ve attached a compressed agenda and a trimmed slide deck for this flow. Can you confirm Mitch is available for the final 20 minutes (approx 11:10–11:30 ET)? If the CTO can only do 20 minutes total, we’ll make the last 20m the focus and cut lower-priority technical demos.

If you prefer the push-back option, tell me the range and I’ll coordinate with Kimberly and Vivek for host coverage.

Next steps: please confirm which you prefer and whether Mitch can commit to the final 20m. I’ll update the calendar invite and share the updated attendee agenda.

Thanks —
Rachel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (555) 322-1198

Attachments: compressed-agenda-30m.docx, theodo-demo-deck-v4.pdf

From: Allison Murray <allison.murray@theodotech.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mitch Hayes <mitch.hayes@theodotech.com>
Date: 2025-07-05T13:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: CTO travel conflict — need to reslot/demo compress?

Rachel —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Mitch confirmed he can join for the last 20 minutes (11:10–11:30 ET) but he explicitly asked that the opening 30 minutes be tightly focused on customer-facing flows and performance numbers (no long implementation deep-dives until after the sponsor leaves). He’s okay with a short technical follow-up afterwards with your engineering team if needed.

We’d like to go with your proposed compressed flow. I’m attaching the internal deck we use for execs — it may help you shape the closing remarks. Also: please block Mitch and me on the updated calendar invite and flag the session as ‘exec join expected at end’.

One more ask: can you preface the session with a two-slide summary of latency/cost improvements we can expect on our workload (bullet points)? That will help Mitch jump straight into Q&A.

Thanks — I’ll leave Mitch on the thread for scheduling confirmation.

Allison
Senior Product Manager | Theodo Tech
allison.murray@theodotech.com

Date: 2025-07-06T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: Coverage plan for July 9 compressed demo (CTO joins last 20m)

Kimberly / Vivek —

Heads-up: Theodo confirmed Mitch (CTO) can join for the final 20 minutes of our July 9 session. They’ve asked that the first 30 minutes be tightly focused on customer-facing flows and measurable latency/cost improvements. Please see the updated attachments Allison sent and the compressed agenda I prepared (attached in the external thread).

Plan:
- Rachel: open and run the 30-minute customer-flow demo (slides 1–12 trimmed).
- Kimberly: be ready to step in at minute ~25 to run the two-slide latency/cost summary and moderate the exec Q&A (slides 13–14).
- Vivek: stay on the line for any deep technical follow-up after Mitch drops, and be prepared to take a 30–45 minute breakout with their infra/ML engineers.

Action items:
- Kimberly: confirm you can lead the exec summary and own slides 13–14.
- Vivek: confirm availability for a post-demo deep-dive (we may schedule for July 10).
- I’ll update the calendar invite to mark the exec segment and include the new agenda + deck.

Thanks — let’s keep this tight. If either of you can’t do the roles above, tell me asap and I’ll escalate to product leadership for backup.

Rachel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
